body:
After thinking about it, there's no default "header" template, you always submit yours. In comparison with the item template where we do have a default template.

So I will just pass collapsable and collapsed data to the header template when you use collapsable option.

Along with the "collapsed" CSS class that already exists.
Those were added to be consistent with already existing "ais-footer" "ais-header".

> What about _getComponent since we get a react component?

Oh yeah, this fine grained difference is insane.. https://facebook.github.io/react/blog/2015/12/18/react-components-elements-and-instances.html

Oh that makes sense. I don't really like what we did for the URL sync but that could be consistent with what you want: 
- type for collapsable `boolean|object`
- having an object (even an empty one) is equivalent to having `true`
- the object can contain an attribute `defaultState:boolean`
